headline: P-13 quick-win thesis REFUTED by collision attack. MAUDE is public but passive surveillance (not predictive ground truth). AI implant failure prediction is already crowded (2025 Hip-Net multicenter study with external validation, 2023 HCRN shunt study ROC AUC 0.733). P-13's 'AI predicts failure' is NOT novel. P-13 downgraded from #1 to #7. P-13's potential differentiator is 'ultra-low-power on-device prediction' — but this is CONDITIONAL on P-08/P-15 energy budget results. Portfolio re-ranked: P-15 (#1, $2K), P-08 (#2, $2K), P-01 (#3, $8K). 3-layer EV upgrade: Modelled/Calibrated/Buyer-verified with hard constraint: machine rejects WTP_state != BUYER_VERIFIED for buyer-confidence claims. 3 parallel tracks: A (quick commercial), B (flagship P-01), C (scientific P-04+P-09). Buyer loop state machine: 10 states with provenance for every transition. Rejection = portfolio evidence, not failure.
